description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class, which implements methods for persisting, revoking, and checking authorization codes within an OAuth2 server context. It interacts with the database via Doctrine ORM and is part of an OAuth plugin for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling OAuth authorization codes, providing methods to persist, revoke, and check revocation status, inheriting from BaseDao and implementing OAuth2's AuthCodeRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and persists a new OAuth authorization code entity to the database based on the provided AuthCodeEntityInterface.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks a given authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a specific authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of an AuthCodeEntity compliant object.
